description: This file provides R class definitions and methods for integrating MLlib recommendation algorithms, specifically focusing on ALS (Alternating Least Squares) models for collaborative filtering within Spark. It includes class definitions, model training, summarization, prediction, and saving/loading functionalities.

classes.name: ALSModel
classes.description: Represents an ALS model with a Java object reference to the Scala ALSWrapper.

methods.name: spark.als
methods.description: Trains an ALS model using specified parameters on a SparkDataFrame.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the trained ALS model, including factors and rank.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Generates predictions from a trained ALS model on new SparkDataFrame data.

methods.name: write.ml
methods.description: Saves the trained ALS model to a specified path, with optional overwrite.
